wages.text: Rivas introduced a farmworker relief package, saying the state must act to protect agricultural workers' economic security.
wages.quote: But as we ask our farmworkers to continue working through the COVID-19 pandemic, we must take action to protect their health, safety, and economic security.

housing.text: Rivas is described as a leader of California's YIMBY movement, which favors building more housing and loosening zoning.
housing.quote: Rivas is a leader of the YIMBY movement in California.

safety.text: Rivas supports state funding for law enforcement while also backing violence prevention, treatment, rehabilitation and criminal justice reforms.
safety.quote: The latest state budget includes $50 million for crime victim services through the Victims of Crime Act program, $20 million for community-based violence prevention and rehabilitation through the RIGHT Grant, $375 million in substance use treatment, mental health treatment and rehabilitation services, and $20 million to fight human trafficking.

immigration.text: Responding to a federal immigration-enforcement killing, Rivas urged Californians to show solidarity with targeted immigrants.
immigration.quote: We need your voice, we need your solidarity, and standing up for American values.

safety.text: Sanchez said he would seek more support for law enforcement while also expanding behavioral health programs to address crises before they become law enforcement emergencies.
safety.quote: I also believe behavioral health resources and law enforcement should complement one another, not be treated as substitutes for each other.
